title: Sherry Loaf Bread
description: A simple bread recipe made with a loaf, perfect for snacking.
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the sherry and 1 tablespoon of water.
Pour the sherry mixture over the bread cubes and toss to coat.
Transfer the bread mixture to a baking sheet and bake for 10-12 minutes, or until golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
